grad.summary: Verified all 40 draft items against <workdir>/ledger/grad_v2_evidence.json. All 40 regex sets compile as Python re (verified programmatically) and none of the statements or rubrics mention atoms/gradients/dictionaries. Verdicts: 28 ok, 12 revised, 0 dropped (every label is non-empty and at least rubric-measurable; rank 5 / atom 8139 has the weakest label-evidence fit and is kept at confidence 1). Revisions: rank 3 (tightened 'the problem says' regex to the '..., so' inference form so it no longer duplicates rank 33), rank 6 (rubric now requires the Unicode-symbol style named in the statement; generic flipped to false), rank 10 (dropped generic '(e.g.,' from the parenthetical regex), rank 15 (dropped non-specific 'the key is to'), rank 18 (added colon-introduced 'Second element:' regex matching the lens/colon evidence), rank 22 (rubric reworded to be answerable from the response alone), rank 24 ('[Hh]old on' case fix), rank 28 (dropped the shared 'Hmm' regex so the set measures the abandonment motive), rank 29 (redundant alternation cleanup), rank 34 (explicit (?m) on sentence-initial 'But'), rank 35 (removed generic 'Example:'/'Input:' headers from the test-case regex), rank 40 (arrow regex relaxed to match example 1). Generic=true retained only for rank 9 (because/since) and rank 32 (which-is relative clauses). Overlap groups list the Wait/hesitation family, Hmm interjections, 'Let me ...' pauses, verification/re-checking, Alternatively/alternatives, sentence-initial But/However, since/because justification, maybe/perhaps hedging, realization/inconsistency, meta-planning, problem-statement reference, concrete traces, edge cases, and So/then connectives; groups share members where an item sits in two families.

act.summary: Verified 40 draft items for the act arm: 29 ok, 11 revised, 0 dropped. All regexes compile under Python re; hit rates were checked on the 40 labeled example chunks per atom (data/label/act_v2_examples.json) against a 4,800-chunk background built from all 60 atoms' example and negative chunks. Labels for the ledger atoms were joined from reports/labels/act_v2_labels.json because the label fields in ledger/act_v2_evidence.json are empty. Revisions: removed prompt-echo or non-diagnostic regexes (rank 2 bare 'flip' and 'mod', rank 4 term enumeration and non-first-person 'make a mistake', rank 7 'number of positive divisors' echo of prompt 3, rank 13 bare 'Hmm', rank 31 'So then'); tightened over-broad patterns (rank 1 approach phrase now needs a preceding verb, rank 3 'corner of', rank 8 parenthetical '(if/(as', rank 32 tally regexes now require a run of 3 tallies or a sentence-final/count-noun context); added coverage where the regex side was near-empty or missed the statement's claim (rank 6 opening-anchored regex, rank 11 substitute-back / satisfies-condition, rank 31 adjustment markers). Generic flags kept for ranks 11, 16, 25. Overlap groups: Wait-negation/redo family, hedged-alternative/'Actually' family, problem-statement re-reading family, verification/double-check family, 'Hmm'/self-talk openers, equation bookkeeping, math-notation density, coordinate geometry, arrow traces, and letter tallies; atoms may appear in more than one group. Final file: <scratch>/final.json

err.summary: Verified 40 err-arm items against data/label/err_v2_labels.json and the 40 stored example chunks per atom (the evidence JSON label fields are empty for all 60 atoms). All regexes compile as Python re; per-item hit rates on own chunks vs the 2400 pooled chunks were computed to check specificity. Verdicts: 6 ok (ranks 1,3,4,8,9,10), 34 revised, 0 dropped. Substantive revisions: rank 2 (+2 grounded problem-reinterpretation regexes), rank 5 (dropped non-specific 'should work'), rank 6 (dropped bare 'perhaps', duplicated by rank 37), rank 7 (replaced non-specific 'Hmm.' with enriched 'Wait no./contradiction' and widened example pattern), rank 14 (dropped bare 'Alternatively' [0.86x enrichment], added enriched 'so/perhaps we can', single yes/no rubric), rank 17 (dropped bare 'Wait' [0.89x], added hedged self-diagnosis regexes), rank 21 (+'Wait, that's different', 'Let's see/check'), rank 22 (dropped bare 'Wait', not enriched), rank 23 (chunks show demonstrative-'that' verdicts 'So that's correct/handled' dominate; statement/regex/rubric widened, 'Hmm' dropped), rank 26 (generic 'Step N:' replaced with iteration-header pattern), rank 29 (generic=true: sentence-initial But/However is near-ubiquitous), rank 33 (+enriched 'that's fine/consistent' regex), rank 40 (capitalized Steps:/Plan: headers). Ranks 11-40 statements normalized to the 'After SFT on this data, model responses will show more ...' template (marked revised even when that was the only change). No item dropped: every label has a measurable move. Overlap: ranks 1-9 and most of 11-24/34/36/38 form one correlated 'Wait'-marked self-correction family; a second family covers hedged alternative proposals (Alternatively/perhaps/maybe); smaller groups: question-then-pivot chains, demonstrative-'that' confirmations (1385/5939), concrete-case walkthroughs, planning/outlining. Global confound: SFT data is R1-style thinking text, so all 'Wait/Hmm/Alternatively' markers rise together regardless of any single atom; per_1k_tokens partly controls for length. Full verified JSON also saved at <scratch>/err_verifier_final_9f3a.json (note: the shared scratchpad 'final.json' was overwritten by a concurrent act-arm session; do not use it).
